# Gramlot examples 0.3.9 — Lessons match the current core and agree in Python and JavaScript

- Python and JavaScript twins agree. A Source parity test compares the Python and JavaScript declarations and page options of all 79 lessons. An endpoint parity test sends the same request envelopes to both languages and compares values, error classes and Source.
- Fixes found by those tests: c09 rounds half up with `floor(x + 0.5)` in both languages. c08 and c11 raise the same named errors (`EmptyOrder`, `OutOfStock`). w10 and w20 start from an exact Decimal in both languages. l08 has `gallery_urls`, the Python twin of `galleryUrls`.
- The lessons teach what the core does. In c04 and c22, `${pixels}px` is literal text; the form is `^.width:{}px`. e10 and e13 use `html_button` and `this`, not `window.gramlot` globals; e13 animates with a `_timing` controller and named Logic. c10, c12, c13 and c14 follow the current request rule of the core. Texts that described controls the pages do not have, and four catalogue descriptions (e04, e05, b09, b11), now match the pages.
- Names follow the naming conventions. The element returned by `html_main` is held in `main_content`. The root generic div is `pane`. Tests reject `page` as the name of an element and `pane` as the name of the main element.
- No lesson lists the base theme in `css`: the server links it. Lessons no longer repeat `.actions`, which the base theme defines: three stylesheets that held only that rule are deleted, and an unused `.form-actions` rule of b09 is dropped. c19 has a stylesheet for its frame.
- A JavaScript page that names no client method exports no `Logic`: 65 of the 79 pages. The gallery shows no logic tab for them, and the manual build writes `index_aux.js` only for a lesson with `Logic`. The tests reject an empty `Logic`.

Requires Gramlot 0.3.6 or later, in Python and JavaScript: a page module without `Logic` loads only with the core 0.3.6. Dependencies remain uncapped.

Hosted galleries need `gramlot-py-server` 0.2.11 and `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server` 0.2.14. Their gallery staging links the module with `export *`, which is valid with and without `Logic`. The serverless gallery (`@gramlot/gramlot-serverless` 0.2.14) writes the companion only for a module that exports `Logic`. Earlier server versions re-export `Logic` by name, which fails for a page without it.
